entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D game animation sprite atlas. Use the reference ONLY as the exact adult character and clothing design reference. Create ONE clean sprite sheet, landscape 2048x1536, EXACTLY 8 equal columns by 6 equal rows, 48 full-body animation cells. Preserve face, hair, ornaments, outfit colors and every major garment silhouette of hehuan-dusk_silk; graceful Chinese fantasy illustration matching reference. Facing right in three-quarter side view in every cell. Same camera, same body scale, feet at 92% of every cell, full character and weapon contained with 10% clear padding inside EACH cell, no frame crosses cell boundaries. The entire background must be truly TRANSPARENT alpha, with no matte, colored glow backdrop, ground, shadow rectangle, drawn grid, numbers or text. Each row is one CONTINUOUS motion sequence with 8 distinct progressively changing poses, small coherent changes between adjacent frames, no eight unrelated poses. ROW1 idle breathing and cloth/hair sway, frame8 loops smoothly to frame1. ROW2 standard fan flick attack: anticipate, wind up, extend, contact at frame5, follow-through, recover. ROW3 heavy spinning fan sweep with larger yet contained movement, same phase order. ROW4 magic channel hand/weapon gesture, from rest through strongest at frame5 back to rest. ROW5 defensive brace and ward gesture, raised protection then settle. ROW6 recoil hurt, lean back then recover to idle. First and last cells of action rows close to row1 idle for seamless transitions. Use minimal tiny intrinsic magic only, no large attack overlays, since battle effects are separate. Only this character, never another costume, maintain complete anatomy in all 48 cells. Eight columns and six rows are mandatory.
